name: C++ 1 — Practice Lab (C++ Basics)
description: Guided learner workspace for the first lab of a beginner C++ course (4×45 min): observing the first program, the preprocessor and macros (#include, #define, -E), conditional compilation (#ifdef, -D, include guards, parameterized macros), and I/O + string + assert debugging — compiled with g++ in the workspace terminal, prediction-first.
